¶ If you wish to have a good intellect for the senses, and not be able to become drunk: take the stone which is called **Amethyst** <note>original: "Amatistus"</note>; it is of purple color, and the best is born in India, and it is effective against drunkenness. And it brings a good intellect for those things which can be known <note>original: "scibilibus"</note>.

<margin>+</margin>
¶ If you wish to overcome enemies and avoid quarrels: take the stone which is called **Beryl** <note>original: "Berillus"</note>; it is of a pale color, with light transparent as water. Carry it with you and you will overcome all quarrels and will put enemies to flight, and it will render the enemy mild. It restores power in manners, as Aaron says; it also gives a good intellect for those things which can be known.

¶ If you wish to divine concerning future events: take the stone which is called **Chelonitis** <note>original: "Chelōytes"</note>; it is of a purple and various color, and it is found in the body of a tortoise. If anyone, however, carries this stone under his tongue, he will divine and predict the future. Nevertheless, it does not have power unless it is shining at first when it has been ignited, and it grows as the moon waxes and wanes. Thus says Aaron concerning the virtues of stones and herbs.

<margin>-</margin>

<margin>+</margin>
If you wish to pacify storms and cross rivers: take the stone which is called **Coral** <note>original: "Corallus"</note>, and it is red and also white. And it is proven that it immediately restrains blood, and being carried, it repels foolishness and provides wisdom; and this has been tested by certain people in our time, and it is effective against storms and the dangers of rivers.

<summary>This page details the mystical and practical properties of four specific stones—Amethyst, Beryl, Chelonitis, and Coral—emphasizing their abilities to grant intellectual clarity, resolve conflicts, facilitate divination, and protect the traveler from natural hazards.</summary>
